purpose: Mechanism and host runtime on old screening histories; no score estimate or tuning.
history_policy: Each bot makes every intervening native decision, corrects to actual saved public move, and receives only own setup and public events. Both colors are prespecified. No final validation or current screen trajectory is inspected.
parity: Read-only native AI_TRACE build from frozen registered candidate archive; each sampled native choice compared with unchanged frozen runtime launcher through every forced prefix. Baseline likewise compared against frozen reference. No goal or move-score tuning.
timing: Sampled whole choose wall time split into native go protocol wait and remaining preparation. Alternating candidate/reference order by game index. Host timing includes interpreter/protocol load and contention; no CX16 timing claim.
output: One compact metadata row per sampled root: side/game/ordinal, changed native choices, actor goal count/differences, full/reference preparation/native times, packet bytes. No full state/trajectory dumps and no outcome filtering.
